sections.title: باب 1 — متن (8)

paras.text: Besides walking, exercise according to the physician’s advice and avoiding the components of salt, ghee and fat in food, the following precautionary measures too are helpful in this regard.
paras.urdu: معالج کی تجویز کے مطابق چہل قدمی، ورزش اور کھانے میں نمک، گھی اور چربی کے اجزاء سے پرہیز کے علاوہ درج ذیل احتیاطی تدابیر بھی اس سلسلے میں معاون ہیں۔
paras.pashto: د ډاکټر د وړاندیز سره سم له ګرځېدو، تمرین او په خواړو کې له مالګې، غوړیو او وازدې څخه له پرهېز سربېره لاندې احتیاطي ګامونه هم په دې برخه کې مرسته کوي.

paras.text: A simple way of life should be adopted and as far as possible a peaceful life should be spent.
paras.urdu: سادہ طرزِ زندگی اختیار کیا جائے اور حتی الامکان پُر سکون زندگی گزاری جائے۔
paras.pashto: ساده ژوند غوره شي او تر وسه ارام ژوند تېر شي.

paras.text: Reasonable timings of eating, drinking, sleeping and waking should be observed.
paras.urdu: کھانے پینے اور سونے جاگنے کے معقول اوقات کا لحاظ رکھا جائے۔
paras.pashto: د خوړلو څښلو او ویده کېدو او ویښېدو معقولو وختونو ته پام وشي.

paras.text: Smoking and other intoxicating things should be avoided.
paras.urdu: تمباکو نوشی اور دیگر نشہ آور چیزوں کے استعمال سے گریز کیا جائے۔
paras.pashto: له تمباکو څکولو او نورو نشه‌يي توکو ډډه وشي.

paras.text: Contentment should be adopted in social matters and oneself should be kept free from too much mental pressure.
paras.urdu: معاشرتی معاملات میں قناعت اختیار کی جائے اور خود کو بہت زیادہ ذہنی دباؤ سے آزاد رکھا جائے۔
paras.pashto: په ټولنیزو چارو کې قناعت غوره شي او ځان له ډېر رواني فشار ازاد وساتل شي.

paras.text: All prescribed medicines should be used on time and no gap should be made in taking medicines.
paras.urdu: تمام تجویز کردہ دواؤں کو بروقت استعمال کیا جائے اور دوا لینے میں ناغہ نہیں کرنا چاہیے۔
paras.pashto: ټول وړاندیز شوي درمل په وخت وکارول شي او د درملو په اخیستو کې ناغه ونه شي.

paras.text: If someone suffers from blood pressure (high blood pressure) and diabetes, then the risk of heart diseases increases; in both these conditions great attention should be paid to abstinence.
paras.urdu: اگر کوئی بلڈ پریشر (بلند فشار خون) اور ذیابیطس کا مرض لاحق ہو جائے تو دل کے امراض کا خدشہ بڑھ جاتا ہے ان دونوں حالتوں میں پرہیز کی طرف بہت توجہ دینی چاہیے۔
paras.pashto: که چا ته د وینې فشار (لوړ فشار) او شکر ناروغي پېښه شي، د زړه د ناروغیو خطر زیاتېږي؛ په دې دواړو حالتونو کې پرهېز ته ډېر پام پکار دی.

paras.text: Dietary restrictions for the heart patient
paras.urdu: دل کے مریض کے لیے غذائی پابندیاں
paras.pashto: د زړه ناروغ لپاره غذايي محدودیتونه

paras.text: Food is a basic need of the body. Besides air and water, every living thing needs food in order to remain alive. Whether food is obtained from plant sources or animal sources, there are some food characteristics in it which in other words are called nutrition (Nutrition). Nutrition depends on the food components present in food. Every food component performs a special work in the body, and without any component growth and health are not possible. Every part of the body needs strength and special food components according to its work. The most work in our body is done by our heart. Because the heart moves continuously, the heart works like a pump in the human body; it supplies blood to all parts of the body. Food plays a very important role in bringing the continuous work of the heart into practice in an effective way; however, in heart diseases special care is taken of food. The heart patient should use the food prescribed by the doctor. Fatty foods and such foods in which there is more cholesterol etc. should not be used at all. Below …

sections.theory:
Precautionary measures

Besides walking, exercise according to the physician’s advice and avoiding the components of salt, ghee and fat in food, the following precautionary measures too are helpful in this regard.

A simple way of life should be adopted and as far as possible a peaceful life should be spent.

Reasonable timings of eating, drinking, sleeping and waking should be observed.

Smoking and other intoxicating things should be avoided.

Contentment should be adopted in social matters and oneself should be kept free from too much mental pressure.

All prescribed medicines should be used on time and no gap should be made in taking medicines.

If someone suffers from blood pressure (high blood pressure) and diabetes, then the risk of heart diseases increases; in both these conditions great attention should be paid to abstinence.

Food is a basic need of the body. Besides air and water, every living thing needs food in order to remain alive. Whether food is obtained from plant sources or animal sources, there are some food characteristics in it which in other words are called nutrition (Nutrition). Every part of the body needs strength and special food components according to its work. The most work in our body is done by our heart. Because the heart moves continuously, the heart works like a pump in the human body; it supplies blood to all parts of the body. Food plays a very important role in bringing the continuous work of the heart into practice in an effective way; however, in heart diseases special care is taken of food. sections.content:
Precautionary measures

Besides walking, exercise according to the physician’s advice and avoiding the components of salt, ghee and fat in food, the following precautionary measures too are helpful in this regard.

A simple way of life should be adopted and as far as possible a peaceful life should be spent.

Reasonable timings of eating, drinking, sleeping and waking should be observed.

Smoking and other intoxicating things should be avoided.

Contentment should be adopted in social matters and oneself should be kept free from too much mental pressure.

All prescribed medicines should be used on time and no gap should be made in taking medicines.

If someone suffers from blood pressure (high blood pressure) and diabetes, then the risk of heart diseases increases; in both these conditions great attention should be paid to abstinence.

Dietary restrictions for the heart patient

Food is a basic need of the body. Besides air and water, every living thing needs food in order to remain alive. Whether food is obtained from plant sources or animal sources, there are some food characteristics in it which in other words are called nutrition (Nutrition). Nutrition depends on the food components present in food. Every food component performs a special work in the body, and without any component growth and health are not possible. Every part of the body needs strength and special food components according to its work. The most work in our body is done by our heart. Because the heart moves continuously, the heart works like a pump in the human body; it supplies blood to all parts of the body. Food plays a very important role in bringing the continuous work of the heart into practice in an effective way; however, in heart diseases special care is taken of food. The heart patient should use the food prescribed by the doctor. Fatty foods and such foods in which there is more cholesterol etc. should not be used at all. Below …

احتیاطی تدابیر

معالج کی تجویز کے مطابق چہل قدمی، ورزش اور کھانے میں نمک، گھی اور چربی کے اجزاء سے پرہیز کے علاوہ درج ذیل احتیاطی تدابیر بھی اس سلسلے میں معاون ہیں۔

سادہ طرزِ زندگی اختیار کیا جائے اور حتی الامکان پُر سکون زندگی گزاری جائے۔

کھانے پینے اور سونے جاگنے کے معقول اوقات کا لحاظ رکھا جائے۔

تمباکو نوشی اور دیگر نشہ آور چیزوں کے استعمال سے گریز کیا جائے۔

معاشرتی معاملات میں قناعت اختیار کی جائے اور خود کو بہت زیادہ ذہنی دباؤ سے آزاد رکھا جائے۔

تمام تجویز کردہ دواؤں کو بروقت استعمال کیا جائے اور دوا لینے میں ناغہ نہیں کرنا چاہیے۔
